issues.explanation: conventions.md:54 points logging guidance at `docs/ops/logging.md`, but the change introduces `docs/ops/observability.md` without updating or linking that referenced file, so the two docs can diverge or leave the convention link pointing at stale content.

The archive/audit assertions depend on LOG_DAILY_DAYS, LOG_AUDIT_LEVEL and LOG_AUDIT_DAYS, but only LOG_STACK is pinned in phpunit.xml:29, so a developer `.env` that overrides those keys would make the tests fail.
The requirement that the audit channel accepts writes is verified only through config values; no test actually calls `Log::channel('audit')->info(...)` to prove the channel is writable.

review.summary: The change adds a well-scoped `App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert` notifier with config-gated no-op, JSON POST, 1800-character multibyte truncation, recursive secret redaction and soft-failing, scrubbed error logging, plus the daily/audit/stack logging configuration, env keys, phpunit pin, docs and thorough Pest tests. Requirements and security are fully met; the only notable deviation is the new docs file not matching the `docs/ops/logging.md` path named in the conventions, with a couple of minor test-robustness nits, so this is an approve-with-nits change.
